The structure of Cd5As2 is tetragonal, space group I4mm (No. 107), with a Cd10As4 unit cell and 14 atoms distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination throughout: As centers have 6 Cd neighbors, while Cd centers have 6 neighbors, either 4 As and 2 Cd or 5 Cd and 1 As, with neighbor distances from about 2.77 to 2.96 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cd octahedra and between As octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
